## File: facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdparty/github/fairinternal/postman/third_party/grpc/third_party/benchmark/tools/compare.py

Prompts

```
['run compare.py benchmarks mode to compare two benchmark JSON output files or executables', 'run compare.py filters mode to compare two filters from a single benchmark file', 'run compare.py benchmarksfiltered mode to compare filters across two different benchmark files', 'run compare.py with alpha flag to set significance level for Mann-Whitney U test', 'run compare.py with display_aggregates_only flag to show only aggregate results from repeated benchmarks', 'run strip_asm.py with an input assembly file and output path to generate a stripped assembly file', 'process an assembly string to strip unwanted directives, comments, and global declarations', 'transform assembly labels by normalizing them and removing unused label declarations', 'process identifiers in assembly lines to normalize names across ELF and MachO platforms', 'find all labels referenced by jump instructions in the assembly code']
```

Usage

```
{'run_benchmark_comparison': 'run compare.py benchmarks mode to compare two benchmark JSON output files or executables', 'run_filtered_comparison': 'run compare.py filters mode to compare two filters from a single benchmark file', 'run_cross_benchmark_filtered_comparison': 'run compare.py benchmarksfiltered mode to compare filters across two different benchmark files', 'run_comparison_with_utest': 'run compare.py with alpha flag to set significance level for Mann-Whitney U test', 'run_comparison_aggregates_only': 'run compare.py with display_aggregates_only flag to show only aggregate results from repeated benchmarks'}
```
